completion_data.completion_summary: Added topic assignment to 6 task creation points across 5 files using Mode C suggest-wrap (fix-it, review), Mode A picker-insert (project-overview), and Mode B inherit-with-fallback (spawn, task --expand, task --review). All inline jq active_topics manipulation replaced with manage-topics.sh calls. All 5 files mirrored to extension copies.

memory_candidates.content: When adding topic assignment to skill/command files in the agent system, use manage-topics.sh subcommands (list, add, set) instead of inline jq. The `set` subcommand calls `add` internally, so standalone `add` is only needed when no `set` follows. Always call `manage-topics.sh set TASK_NUM TOPIC` AFTER the task entry exists in state.json (exits 4 if task not found). Wrap all calls non-blocking: `2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning...'`.
